decisions.rationale: Incineroar + Rotom-Wash lead: Fake Out (+3) flinches Whimsicott before Prankster Tailwind, while Volt Switch guarantees OHKO on Pelipper and pivots into Serperior. Intimidate weakens physical Swift Swim sweepers. Serperior enters safely and threatens every Water-type with Contrary Leaf Storm. Mega Metagross in back handles Whimsicott (Steel→Fairy) and Primarina, with Bullet Punch priority to finish Sashed targets.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lead: Incineroar+Rotom-Wash with Serperior+Metagross back. Opponent rain core: Pelipper(Damp Rock)/Mega Swampert/Basculegion(Scarf)+Whimsicott(Focus Sash)/Primarina/Ampharos. Key facts: Rotom-W Volt Switch OHKOs Pelipper; Serperior Leaf Storm OHKOs Mega Swampert, 86-156% on Basculegion; Pelipper Hurricane 89-136% on Serperior (risky lead); Whimsicott Sash survives any single hit; Fake Out is only reliable turn-1 Tailwind denial. Incineroar Dark-type immune to Prankster.

decisions.rationale: Bring Pelipper and Swampert as our starting lead to immediately establish Drizzle rain and unleash Mega Swampert's Swift Swim speed and power. Back them up with Basculegion to clean up with Choice Scarf Swift Swim and Whimsicott for Prankster Tailwind support if speed control needs refreshing.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 lead: Pelipper + Swampert, back Basculegion + Whimsicott.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out Pelipper prevents Tailwind and Weather Ball; Volt Switch guarantees OHKO on Pelipper (131–260%) and pivots into Serperior. Swampert may Mega Evolve and attack Incineroar, but Focus Sash ensures survival. Serperior then threatens Swampert with a guaranteed Leaf Storm OHKO next turn. Removing Pelipper early denies Tailwind and limits rain resets, while preserving momentum with the Volt Switch pivot.

Both Pelipper and Swampert protect on turn 1 to scout the opponent's moves (such as Fake Out from Incineroar and potential Hydro Pump or Volt Switch from Rotom-Wash) while ensuring Swampert safely Mega Evolves and gains Swift Swim under Rain.

Parting Shot Swampert-Mega to stack -2 Atk while pivoting to Serperior, Volt Switch Pelipper for the guaranteed OHKO and a pivot. Swampert moves first but Incineroar lives any single hit with Sash; even if double-targeted and Pelipper wins the speed tie, the worst case is trading Incineroar for Pelipper plus Serperior vs -1 Swampert. Serperior OHKOs Swampert with Leaf Storm next turn.

Serperior OHKOs Mega Swampert with Leaf Storm and survives any single hit from the opponent's likely attackers (Ice Punch 41-59%, Wave Crash 43-63%, Moonblast 30-48%). Even if Swampert outspeeds in rain, Serperior tanks the hit and KOs back, gaining a +2 SpA Contrary boost. Incineroar at 1% stays in as a sacrifice to absorb one attack, protecting Serperior from being doubled. Metagross is preserved in back for later.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Lead Incineroar+Rotom-Wash, back Serperior+Metagross. Turn 1 both sides Protected. Turn 2 Swampert Waterfall brought Incineroar to Sash (1%), Rotom Volt Switch KO'd Pelipper. Now Volt Switch forces Rotom out; switching to Serperior. Opponent rain core: Pelipper(Damp Rock)/Mega Swampert/Basculegion(Scarf)+Whimsicott(Focus Sash)/Primarina/Ampharos. Serperior Leaf Storm OHKOs Mega Swampert (4x Grass into Water/Ground). Basculegion is Swift Swim+Scarf, extremely fast in rain. Whimsicott has Prankster Tailwind/Encore but Incineroar is Dark-immune to Prankster. Key: Serperior must connect Leaf Storm on Swampert to snowball.

decisions.rationale: Incineroar must switch after Parting Shot. Rotom-Wash is the optimal switch: Levitate grants immunity to Swampert-Mega's Earthquake, it resists Waterfall and Ice Punch, and it provides a pivot with Volt Switch against potential Basculegion or Primarina switches. Metagross takes neutral from both Earthquake and Waterfall and lacks recovery. Serperior stays in; Leaf Storm is a guaranteed OHKO on Swampert-Mega, forcing the opponent to Protect or switch, both of which give us momentum.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Lead Incineroar+Rotom-Wash, back Serperior+Metagross. Turn 1 both sides Protected. Turn 2 Swampert Waterfall brought Incineroar to Sash (1%), Rotom Volt Switch KO'd Pelipper. Volt Switch forced Rotom out; switched to Serperior. Incineroar used Parting Shot on Swampert (-2 Atk, -1 SpA) and is switching to Rotom-Wash. Opponent rain core: Pelipper(Damp Rock)/Mega Swampert/Basculegion(Scarf)+Whimsicott(Focus Sash)/Primarina/Ampharos. Serperior Leaf Storm OHKOs Mega Swampert (4x). Basculegion is Swift Swim+Scarf, extremely fast in rain. Whimsicott has Prankster Tailwind/Encore but Incineroar is Dark-immune to Prankster. Key: Serperior must connect Leaf Storm on Swampert to snowball with Contrary boosts.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper uses Weather Ball into Incineroar (super-effective in rain, taking out or heavily damaging Incineroar) and Swampert-Mega uses Waterfall into Incineroar or Rotom-Wash (Waterfall into Incineroar ensures a KO or high damage). Since Incineroar used Fake Out last turn and cannot use it again, and Rotom-Wash used Volt Switch last turn (likely switching or attacking Pelipper's slot, but Pelipper is threatening Incineroar while Swampert outspeeds and hits hard), doubling into Incineroar is safe and pressures the opponent immediately.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Lead Pelipper + Swampert-Mega against Incineroar + Rotom-Wash. Pelipper has damp rock (rain active). Swampert-Mega has swift swim.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper fainted last turn, so we must replace it. Bringing in Basculegion under rain gives us a strong Swift Swim physical attacker with Wave Crash and Last Respects, while Swampert-Mega passes its turn to accommodate the replacement switch.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Pelipper fainted to Rotom-Wash Volt Switch on Turn 2, and Serperior switched in via Parting Shot. Rain is active for several more turns. Basculegion has Swift Swim and Choice Scarf.

decisions.rationale: Serperior Leaf Storm OHKOs Swampert-Mega guaranteed (145.9-252.6%) and gains +2 SpA via Contrary, snowballing into a win condition. Rotom-Wash Volt Switch damages Basculegion (45.8-86.2%) and pivots for momentum. Basculegion moves first but cannot OHKO Serperior alone (Wave Crash 42.7-62.7%; Last Respects ~48-72% at 100 BP). Swampert may Protect, but if it does Leaf Storm is merely blocked while Volt Switch still connects. Worst case double-target on Serperior with Swampert winning the speed tie has only a partial KO chance; the upside of removing Mega Swampert and boosting Serperior is decisive.

Rotom must switch after Volt Switch. Switching to Incineroar triggers Intimidate, dropping Swampert to -3 Atk and Basculegion to -1 Atk, which helps Serperior survive future turns. Serperior uses Protect to guarantee survival this turn. If Incineroar is KO'd (likely), Metagross enters for free without taking a hit. If Incineroar survives, it threatens Fake Out next turn. Either way, Serperior is preserved to OHKO Swampert with Leaf Storm next turn and snowball with Contrary.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Lead Incineroar+Rotom-Wash, back Serperior+Metagross. Opponent rain core: Pelipper(Damp Rock)/Mega Swampert/Basculegion(Choice Scarf)+Whimsicott(Focus Sash)/Primarina/Ampharos. Serperior Leaf Storm OHKOs Mega Swampert (4x) and gains +2 SpA via Contrary. Basculegion is Swift Swim+Scarf, extremely fast in rain. Incineroar's Intimidate and Parting Shot are key for weakening physical attackers. Metagross-Mega provides Steel-type priority (Bullet Punch) and Tough Claws-boosted attacks. Rotom-Wash has Levitate for Swampert's Earthquake immunity and Volt Switch for momentum.

decisions.rationale: Basculegion outspeeds everything with Swift Swim and Choice Scarf, so Last Respects hits Serperior cleanly. Swampert-Mega protects against Serperior's Leaf Storm or Rotom's moves while Basculegion attacks.
decisions.notebook: Serperior and Rotom-Wash are outsped by Swift Swim Basculegion.

decisions.rationale: Incineroar Fake Out (priority +3) flinches Swampert-Mega before it moves, preventing Ice Punch or Earthquake chip that could combine with Last Respects to KO Serperior. Basculegion is locked into Last Respects and deals 16.7–24% to Serperior, leaving it at 8–15.3%. Serperior then Leaf Storms Basculegion for a guaranteed KO from 13% and gains +2 SpA via Contrary. End state: Incineroar 1%, Serperior 8–15.3% +2 SpA vs Swampert-Mega 100% -3 Atk -1 SpA, with Metagross and Rotom-Wash in back. Even if Swampert Protects, it wastes its turn and Basculegion still falls.

Switch Metagross into Incineroar's slot; Mega Evolve on entry for Tough Claws. Serperior stays in and should Leaf Storm Swampert-Mega. Swampert-Mega is choice-locked into staying (opponent's only remaining bench Pokémon replaces Basculegion). Leaf Storm is a guaranteed OHKO even from 89% HP and gives +2 SpA via Contrary. Speed order Serperior (181) vs Swampert (180–244) is uncertain, but the risk/reward favors attacking: if Serperior moves first, Swampert faints and Serperior reaches +4 SpA — a winning position. If Swampert moves first and Ice Punches Serperior, Serperior falls but Metagross-Mega enters safely and faces a -3 Atk Swampert whose Earthquake does only 27–38% while Zen Headbutt (Tough Claws boosted ~33–58%) 2HKOs back. Rotom-Wash is preserved in the back as a Levitate pivot immune to Swampert's Ground moves.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Lead Incineroar+Rotom-Wash, back Serperior+Metagross. Opponent rain core: Pelipper(Damp Rock)/Mega Swampert/Basculegion(Choice Scarf)+one of Whimsicott(Focus Sash)/Primarina/Ampharos. Serperior Leaf Storm OHKOs Mega Swampert (4x) and gains +2 SpA via Contrary. Basculegion is Swift Swim+Scarf, extremely fast in rain. Incineroar's Intimidate and Parting Shot are key for weakening physical attackers. Metagross-Mega provides Steel-type priority (Bullet Punch) and Tough Claws-boosted attacks. Rotom-Wash has Levitate for Swampert's Earthquake immunity and Volt Switch for momentum. Swampert-Mega speed range 180-244 in rain vs Serperior 181 — speed tie uncertainty on whether Serperior outspeeds. Opponent's last unrevealed Pokémon is one of Whimsicott/Primarina/Ampharos; Whimsicott most synergistic with rain (Prankster Tailwind).

decisions.rationale: Basculegion outspeeds both opponents under rain and Swift Swim and easily KOs the 1% Incineroar with Last Respects. Swampert-Mega can target Serperior with Waterfall to secure major damage or a KO, or we can use Swampert appropriately. Since Incineroar has 1% HP, hitting it with Last Respects is a guaranteed KO while freeing Swampert to pressure Serperior.
decisions.notebook: Serperior and Rotom-Wash are outsped by Swift Swim Basculegion. Basculegion is locked into Last Respects.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Switch Serperior out to preserve it; switches resolve before moves so Serperior escapes safely. Mega Evolve Metagross for Tough Claws and Bullet Punch Whimsicott to break Focus Sash. Whimsicott's Prankster Tailwind goes first but can't stop the switch or Bullet Punch. Rotom-Wash enters immune to Swampert's Earthquake and resists Ice Punch (4.5–9.6%). Next turn Metagross-Mega Bullet Punch KOs the 1 HP Whimsicott, leaving a 2v1 against a -3 Atk Swampert with Serperior still in reserve.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent's last is Whimsicott (Focus Sash, Prankster). Swampert-Mega at -3 Atk is offensively crippled. Serperior Leaf Storm is a guaranteed OHKO on Swampert-Mega (4x). Rotom-Wash is immune to Swampert's Earthquake and takes negligible damage from Ice Punch. Preserving Serperior for the Swampert KO is the win condition.

decisions.rationale: Whimsicott outspeeds both opponents and can use Moonblast on Serperior to finish off its remaining 22% HP (or Encore it). Swampert-Mega can use Ice Punch on Serperior to secure the KO if Moonblast rolls low, while Whimsicott handles Serperior directly.
decisions.notebook: Serperior runs Life Orb and Contrary; Metagross runs Metagrossite and Clear Body. Rotom-Wash has Sitrus Berry and Levitate.

decisions.rationale: Bullet Punch (+1 priority) breaks Whimsicott's Focus Sash, leaving it at 1 HP. Volt Switch then KOs the 1 HP Whimsicott and pivots Rotom-Wash to Serperior. Swampert-Mega at -3 Atk cannot threaten either slot meaningfully (EQ into Metagross 25-35%, Ice Punch into Rotom 6-8%). Even if Whimsicott Protects, we lose little; if it Encores, the target still executes its planned move and Volt Switch still KOs. Next turn Serperior Leaf Storm OHKOs Swampert-Mega for the game.

Whimsicott Protects to shield itself from Metagross's Bullet Punch or Rotom's attack. Swampert-Mega uses Earthquake, which hits both opposing Metagross and Rotom (Levitate applies to Rotom? Wait, Rotom has Levitate so Earthquake misses Rotom, but hits Metagross-Mega super effectively). Let's check Swampert's Earthquake into Metagross-Mega and Whimsicott Protect.
decisions.notebook: Serperior and Metagross-Mega/Rotom-Wash are remaining. Swampert-Mega is at -3 Attack, so Earthquake is our best spread/heavy hitting option against Metagross-Mega while Whimsicott protects.

decisions.rationale: Bullet Punch from Metagross is a guaranteed OHKO on the 31% Whimsicott (50.3–97.8%) and its +1 priority ties Prankster Tailwind/Encore, preventing Whimsicott from safely setting up. Hydro Pump from Rotom into Swampert-Mega deals 47.8–82.3%, leaving it in easy cleanup range for Serperior's Leaf Storm next turn. Swampert's -3 Atk Earthquake only does 24.5–34.8% to Metagross and cannot KO Rotom (immune). Even if Whimsicott's 1/3 Protect succeeds, the board remains strongly in our favour.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Whimsicott uses Protect to shield itself from Metagross-Mega's priority Bullet Punch (and potential Rotom-Wash attacks), while Mega Swampert uses Earthquake to deal heavy super-effective spread damage to Metagross-Mega (and hit Rotom-Wash, bypassing its Levitate immunity).
decisions.notebook: Swampert-Mega and Whimsicott vs Metagross-Mega and Rotom-Wash in rain; protect + earthquake is the safe sequence.

decisions.rationale: Swampert-Mega is the last foe at 7% HP. Bullet Punch (+1 priority) is a guaranteed OHKO and outspeeds all Swampert attacks except Protect. Hydro Pump is backup: if Protect succeeds (low odds on 3rd consecutive use), both moves are blocked but Swampert wastes its turn, and we go to turn 9 with rain expired, Metagross faster, and Protect even less reliable. If Protect fails, Bullet Punch KOs and the game ends.
decisions.notebook: Game 1: Opponent's last is Swampert-Mega at -3 Atk, -1 SpA. Serperior Leaf Storm is a guaranteed OHKO on Swampert-Mega (4x). Rotom-Wash is immune to Swampert's Earthquake and takes negligible damage from Ice Punch. Preserving Serperior for the Swampert KO is the win condition.

decisions.rationale: Swampert-Mega uses Earthquake to hit Metagross-Mega super effectively while Whimsicott is fainted.
decisions.notebook: Swampert-Mega can clean up Metagross-Mega with Earthquake since Rotom-Wash is immune.

reflections.summary: We won by removing Pelipper on turn 2, denying permanent rain and Swift Swim, then stacking Intimidate and Parting Shot to reduce Swampert-Mega to -3 Attack. This made Swampert’s Earthquakes weak and allowed Rotom-Wash and Metagross-Mega to clean up safely, with Serperior preserved as a backup threat.
reflections.adjustment: Next game, expect the opponent to protect Pelipper more carefully or lead Whimsicott to set Tailwind early. Consider leading Incineroar + Serperior to pressure Swampert immediately, and be cautious of Whimsicott’s Encore locking us into Protect or setup moves.
reflections.notebook: Opponent rain: Pelipper (Damp Rock), Swampert-Mega, Basculegion (Choice Scarf, Swift Swim), Whimsicott (Focus Sash, Encore). They double-Protected turn 1. Swampert was debuffed to -3 Atk. Basculegion’s Last Respects is strong even without rain. Whimsicott has Encore. Game 2: may bring Ampharos-Mega or Primarina; may lead Whimsicott + Basculegion for fast Tailwind. Our Intimidate cycling and Rotom-Wash are key. Serperior OHKOs Swampert. Avoid giving Encore opportunities; consider leading Incineroar + Serperior to pressure early.

reflections.summary: The opponent successfully neutralized Pelipper early with Volt Switch and controlled momentum with Incineroar's Parting Shot and Fake Out cycles, while Serperior and Metagross-Mega dismantled our offensive core.
reflections.adjustment: Bring Whimsicott earlier or position Tailwind safely to outspeed the opponent's backline before being overwhelmed by priority moves.
reflections.notebook: Opponent brings Serperior, Metagross-Mega, Incineroar, and Rotom-Wash. Rotom-Wash uses Volt Switch and Levitate to dodge Ground moves. Swampert-Mega can clean up Metagross-Mega with Earthquake since Rotom-Wash is immune.
